acceptableAlternatives: Use the workload identity token; do not place a static key in CI.
Use a short-lived workload identity token, not a static service key.
Verify the SHA-256 manifest before extracting the archive.
Check the archive against its SHA-256 manifest before extraction.
Retry with the original idempotency key and unchanged payload.
Reuse the original idempotency key with the same payload.
Use a 90-second visibility lease.
The indexing lease is 90 seconds.
Check cancellation immediately before commit and leave the manifest uncommitted if cancelled.
A cancelled upload must not commit the manifest; check cancellation immediately before commit.
Add the replacement nullable column before backfilling; retain the old column until readers have migrated.
First add the new nullable column, then backfill, and keep the old column until reader migration is verified.
Encrypt snapshot data with a data key and wrap that key with the vault backup wrapping key.
Use envelope encryption with a data key wrapped by the vault backup wrapping key.
Install offline from the pinned dependency mirror using the committed lockfile.
Use the committed lockfile and pinned mirror for an offline installation.
Keep the authentication scheme and redact the credential value.
Retain only the scheme; replace the credential with [REDACTED].
Require an observed zero exit status and the expected artifact digest.
Success needs exit code zero plus the expected artifact digest.
Quarantine the event and request clock reconciliation while retaining both timestamps.
Keep the original and ingest timestamps, quarantine the event, and reconcile the clock.
Require a live controller lease and a current fencing token for promotion.
Promote only with an unexpired lease and a non-stale fencing token.
Allow credentialed requests only when the complete origin exactly matches the approved list.
Require an exact full-origin match in the approved allowlist for credentialed requests.
Verify the signature over the raw body bytes and timestamp before parsing JSON, and reject expired timestamps.
Before JSON parsing, validate the raw-body signature and timestamp replay window.
Write and fsync a temporary manifest, verify its artifacts, then atomically rename it to the final path.
Publish by atomic rename after fsyncing the temporary manifest and verifying referenced artifacts.
Validate the certificate chain against configured roots and match the exact service identity.
Require both a valid chain to configured trust roots and an exact service-identity match.
Restore into a clean database and compare verification queries with the recorded baseline.
A clean-database restore with baseline query verification establishes restorability.
Include tenant identity, permission-scope digest, and configuration revision.
The cache key must bind the tenant, permission scope digest, and configuration revision.
Carry forward the logical operation ledger and consume only its remaining attempts.
Reuse the original attempt ledger; retries may spend only the remaining allowance.

Workers must use the scoped request endpoint without access to the privileged control socket.
Enforce the timeout with the monotonic clock and use wall-clock time only for audit.
Use monotonic elapsed time for the timeout; retain wall-clock timestamps for auditing.
Verify stream identity, sequence continuity, and the previous event digest before accepting later events.
Resume only after checking the checkpoint stream identity, sequence, and prior event digest.
